subject: FinEdge integration — recap, timing, and next steps

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finedge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-03T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: FinEdge integration — recap, timing, and next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary from today
- Primary goal: integrate Redwood inference for low-latency text generation in FinEdge's underwriting workflow (70–150 tokens per request).
- Top constraints: PII controls, VPC-only deployment for production, and predictable latency under 120ms p99.
- Current pilot scope: integrate model for scoring prototype (10k requests/day), evaluate cost and latency profiles.

Open questions we flagged
1) Does FinEdge require on-prem (air-gapped) or will VPC-hosted be sufficient for pilot?
2) Who owns procurement & legal for sandbox access (I saw Procurement on the invite — is there a single contact)?
3) Target pilot start window (you mentioned "mid-June" as a possibility).

Proposed next steps
- Redwood: provide RFI answers (attached) and a sandbox invite for the engineering team (we can provision access once we have procurement point of contact). Owner: Jordan. ETA: 48 hours.
- FinEdge: confirm procurement contact and whether VPC deployment is acceptable for pilot. Owner: Alex. ETA: EOW (May 7).

Attachments: FinEdge_Discovery_Notes_20260503.pdf (85KB) — notes from our call; RFI_answers_FinEdge.pdf (stub)

If that matches your view, I'll go ahead and schedule a short technical walkthrough with Dev and Soojin next week.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
